newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:
Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commissioner Franz Fischler might hold a news conference on BSE following Wednesday's Commission meeting.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/524: Commission reassures Russia of the benefits of WTO membership.
- IP/97/525: The Commission approves a concentration in the sectors of retail grocery and "do it yourself" in Italy.
- IP/97/526: Conference "21st Century: The Communications Age".
- Eurostat new release No 41/97: EU records 'outstanding' trade with Hong Kong.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Economy and Finance No 1997-19: Harmonized indices of consumer prices - April 97.
- Choosing the common face of the euro coins.
- Provisional agenda of Wednesday's Commission meeting.
